# HSD shader provenance

Ploaj/HSDLib revision 85567e40797de3c820a55476eca54c704921a848.
MIT license; see LICENSE. Only five original material fragment modules are copied.
Fighterport compiles adapted strings for its existing OpenGL viewport: eight texture
units/UV sets, compatibility profile and CPU skinning with all influences.
No upstream application shell, six-weight shader or 200-bone GPU limit is used.
Native scene/game-light, shadow/context, material-animation and game acceptance
remain separate from static native HSD material rendering.
